newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates firm above 23pct on tax payments.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates firm above 23pct on tax payments.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed a little firmer on the interbank money market on Thursday, mostly boosted by tax payments, dealers said.
The overnight rates closed at 23.125 percent, above Wednesday's close of 22.625 percent and also above the opening rate of 23.00 percent, dealers said.
Most deals were concluded in a narrow range between 22.875 and 23.125 percent.
"The rise was probably the result of tax payments," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank. "The 10th (of any month) is the deadline for social security payments."
Dealers expected the overnight rates to retreat on Friday to around 22.75 percent, the rate of the one-week reverse repo facility.
